sources.text: There is a strong possibility that you may switch over to a newer and more exciting job today, predicts Ganesha. You are likely to spend lavishly while on a shopping spree.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Taurus, you're demystifying the concept of talent. You used to look enviously at other people and think, "I wish I had a natural ability like that." Now you understand that the person who aroused your envy with is just someone who had the self-confidence to go to work and refine and develop an aptitude. It's a matter of hard work, belief in oneself, and bravery in the face of risk. You can do it, too!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Emotional buildup must be addressed before you can steadily move forward, darling Taurus. Sit with your feelings while the Aquarius quarter Moon aspects the nodes of fate, Jupiter, Mars, and Chiron. Identify what you need to feel nurtured and balanced, noting how much of this you can provide for yourself and whether outside support is necessary. Enjoy nostalgic comforts without getting stuck in the past. Lean into practices that will fortify the spirit so you can find the strength to get on with your life. A desire for community brings you out of your shell once Luna enters Pisces this afternoon. However, you should avoid social spheres that stir up insecurities when Uranus grows restless tonight.

An old issue might crop up in between you two during a humorus discussion, which will eventually convert into an argument.

In order to be an active thinker, it helps to keep an active body. Especially for a sign which tends to get bogged down by the inequalities of everyday life.
